structured.answer: By its own banner, nothing on this page is calculated yet: gold (ETC, gold ETFs), corporate and Bonds-Israel bonds, structured products and deposits, foreign-currency deposits and accounts, the FX fee, hedged funds, digital wallets, investment-linked and managers' insurance, insurance funds, annuity commutation and 190, REITs and robo-advisors. It also says it will never cover stock picking, trading, derivatives, loans or physical real estate. So my plain index ETFs are probably fine to check there, but my single stocks and what I pay on FX are not.
